critique: The render has a convincing String Twist appearance: many fine mint/cyan parallel strings form a broad, symmetric pinched wave against clean black, with clear twist crossings at both side edges. However, frames 1 and 4 are visually identical, so the preset currently has no observable motion. A String Twist preset should read as flowing/twisting rather than as a completely frozen string lattice.

suggestions.why: Animating the existing Flow X control should introduce a gentle continuous progression through the string field while preserving the established shape and composition.
